strings.В МФЦ мне выдали отказ. Я думал, это зна: The MFC handed me a refusal. I thought that meant my documents had never been accepted. But the receipt has an acceptance number, and the refusal bears another authority's signature.
strings.В вымышленном деле МФЦ принял и своеврем: In this fictional case, the MFC accepted and promptly forwarded the package. After reviewing it, the service authority issued a reasoned refusal of the service itself. The applicant challenges that refusal; the MFC merely issued the result.
strings.В данном упражнении счёт начинается со с: In this exercise, counting starts on the day after registration; a deadline falling on a non-working day moves to the next working day. This is a separate task about the deadline for the specified action, not about fully resolving the real-life problem.
strings.В двух исходных вариантах пакет не прини: In the two original variants, the package was not accepted. Here, acceptance and transfer have occurred: the subject, addressee and deadline change.
strings.Вернуть жалобу только потому, что отрица: Return the complaint solely because the negative result was issued at an MFC counter.
strings.Вернуться к предмету жалобы: подтвержден: Return to the complaint's subject: confirming timely acceptance does not answer whether refusal of the service was lawful.
strings.Вы работаете в подразделении, обеспечива: You work in the unit supporting consideration of a complaint by the proper recipient. Prepare materials and a draft reasoned decision; do not assume the powers of the body providing the service. The case documents determine the specific recipient. This training service applies Chapter 2.1 of Law No. 210-ФЗ; no other special federal procedure is specified.
The general complaint period under Chapter 2.1 is selected.
strings.Выбрать адресата решения об услуге и отл: Choose the proper addressee for the service decision and distinguish the general complaint period from the shortened period for refusal to accept documents.

strings.Граждане и все материалы инцидента вымыш: The citizens and all incident materials are fictional. Any conditions of a particular service given here are a training model, not a quotation from real regulations. Act within your role. The calendar task concerns only the action it specifies.

strings.Нет. Жалоба только на отказ в результате: No. The complaint concerns only the refusal following review; no other federal procedure is specified.
strings.Обжалуется отказ в предоставлении услуги: The complaint concerns refusal to provide the service, not the MFC's refusal to accept documents; the decision's signature determines the route.
strings.Обращение рассматривается в пределах ком: An appeal is considered within jurisdiction; any special procedure requires a separate check. General written-reply periods are not the same as deadlines for repairs, benefits or register corrections.
strings.Основание отказа в предоставлении услуги: The ground for refusing the service, not acceptance of the package.
strings.Отменить решение другого органа от имени: Cancel another authority's decision on behalf of the MFC
strings.Отправлено {{sent}}, поступило {{receive: Sent on {{sent}}, received on {{received}}, registered on {{registered}}. The latest event in the materials is dated {{observed}}. Do not confuse the complaint deadline with the service deadline or the time needed to resolve the problem.
strings.Первый фрагмент пересказывает условие за: The first passage restates the task conditions, not real regulations or a website extract. The external link verifies the legal basis, not the incident's facts.
strings.Передать жалобу на решение уполномоченно: Forward the complaint against the decision to the authorised recipient within the service authority, preserving the prescribed method of submission through the MFC.
strings.Подготовить передачу по предусмотренному: Prepare forwarding through the prescribed route without independently cancelling the act

strings.Применить пять дней ко всем отрицательны: Apply five days to every negative decision.

strings.Профиль исчисления этого упражнения: исх: This exercise's calculation profile excludes the starting day and rolls the deadline forward, using the federal five-day working week. It is not a rule for every procedure.

strings.Расписка подтверждает приём. Обжалуемый: The receipt confirms acceptance. The disputed act was issued by the service-providing body; it refuses the service, not acceptance of documents. Under the general procedure, this subject has a fifteen-working-day complaint consideration period.
strings.Сведения о другом заявителе, объекте или: Information about another applicant, facility or period does not replace verification in this case. A body's name does not grant an employee unlimited powers.
strings.Сверить расписку и автора решения: Check the receipt and who issued the decision
strings.Сначала определите действие, для которог: First identify the action to which the deadline applies. Applying for a service, registering a complaint and resolving a problem are not the same event.
strings.Сокращённый срок связан с названным зако: The shortened period is linked to the subject specified by law, not a single word in the document.
strings.Сопоставьте вывод с документами и провер: Compare the conclusion with the documents and check the limits of authority.
